title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 608  An Act Converting the Bani Barangay High School in the Municipality of Masinloc, Province of Zambales, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Bani National High School and Appropriating Funds therefor.
title.orig: Batas Pambansa Blg. 608  An Act Converting the Bani Barangay High School in the Municipality of Masinloc, Province of Zambales, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Bani National High School and Appropriating Funds therefor.
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Bani Barangay tại Thị trấn Masinloc, Tỉnh Zambales thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Bani Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bani Barangay ในเทศบาล Masinloc จังหวัด Zambales เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bani แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Bani Barangay di Kotamadya Masinloc, Provinsi Zambales menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bani Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Bani Barangay di Perbandaran Masinloc, Wilayah Zambales kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bani Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Bani Barangay High School in the Municipality of Masinloc, Province of Zambales, is
converted into a national high school to be known as the Bani National High School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 24, 1983
